title: elymus glaucus var. virescens
intro: Elymus glaucus var. virescens, commonly known as Green Wild Rye, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Green Wild Rye include its ability to stimulate digestion and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
